# Draft:Ted Morris Memorial Trophy and Bruce Coulter Award

The Ted Morris Memorial Trophy and Bruce Coulter Award are the honours awarded by U Sports to the two most valuble players of the Vanier Cup, Canada's university football national championship game. The Ted Morris Memorial Trompy is awarded to the game's most valuable player, while the Bruce Coulter Award is awarded to the best play who played in a different position than the Ted Morris Memorial Trophy winner. For example, if an offensive player wins the Ted Morris Memorial Trophy, than the best defensive player will win the Bruce Coulter Award.
The Ted Morris Memorial Trophy has been awarded since the 1st Vanier Cup in 1965, while the Bruce Coulter Award was first presented at the 28th Vanier Cup in 1992.
The trophies are named after Teddy Morris and Bruce Coulter.
